svg.text: A chessboard that sees, thinks and moves its own pieces. A camera on a Raspberry Pi 5
reads your move, Stockfish answers, a magnet under the board slides the reply.
Scores the mood of your feed. A Chrome extension captures what you scroll past, a
fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa reads code-mixed Bengali-English, a dashboard charts it.
A digital library. Read EPUB and PDF in the browser, join collaborative reading
rooms, get AI recommendations, and moderate it all from a Filament admin panel.
